chunks: And yet there are men who contend about God without understanding, and follow every wayward devil
ai.seo_question: Who are the people that contend about God without knowledge?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the hypocrites (Munafiqun) who engage in theological disputes not for truth, but to mislead others, following the 'rebellious devil' (Shaytan al-Marid) who represents the ultimate source of deviation. It underscores the necessity of grounding belief in divine knowledge rather than mere rhetoric, a key theme in understanding the transition from the era of the Imams to the Great Occultation.
